title: Acquirer: Magnadata International Limited; Target: Spectron Transit Tickets Pty Ltd

body_sections.Summary: MIL, through its subsidiary, Magnadata Pty Limited ("Magnadata") proposes to acquire the magnetic stripe ticketing division of Spectron Transit Tickets Pty Limited ("Spectron").
body_sections.Market definition: For competition analysis purposes the relevant market was taken to be the national market for the manufacture and supply of magnetic stripe ticketing.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The Commission was of the view that the acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in the market for the following reasons: - there appear to be several competitors capable of constraining the merged firm; - this acquisition does not breach the Commission's market concentration threshholds; - imports appear to be a viable source of current and potential competition. Independent imports represent 14 per cent of the market; - purchasers appear to have some degree of countervailing power in their ability to purchase imports; and - technological developments such as the increasing use of smart cards provide a competitive constraint on the merged firm.
